evidence: All 6 conservation_regression tests pass: grazing, feeding, mortality/senescence, trim-and-remove, trim-and-leave, water-change (6 passed, 0 failed).

E2e conservation suite passes all 6 scenarios with correct delta magnitudes: closed-system scenarios (grazing, feeding, mortality_senescence, trim_and_leave) show +0.000000000 drift; open-system scenarios (trim_and_remove: dN=-38.5, dC=-240.625; water_change: dN=+20.0, dC=+97.5) show expected import/export deltas.
cargo clippy -p tank_core -p tank_harness -- -D warnings passes cleanly with no warnings.

All 6 tests have descriptive doc comments explaining the conservation story being tested (grazing lines 236-243, feeding lines 303-370, mortality lines 509-520, trim-remove lines 618-624, trim-leave lines 707-712, water-change lines 862-871).
All tests enable Detail-verbosity tracing via engine.enable_tracing(SimTracer::new(Verbosity::Detail)).

All pathway assertions use assert_or_dump() / assert_close_or_dump() / assert_trace_delta() helpers that dump the full trace to /tmp/tank_conservation_traces/ or /tmp/tank_conservation_e2e_traces/ on failure.
Tolerance constant TOL = 1e-6 is used consistently across all conservation checks via assert_conserved() and assert_per_tick_balanced().
E2e runner produces a formatted summary table (pass/fail per scenario with dN/dC magnitudes) and exits non-zero on any failure via assert_eq!(failed_count, 0, ...).
Export actions are properly distinguished from in-tank routing via is_open_system_action_label() covering feed, water_change, siphon_detritus, add/remove_shrimp, and trim_plants_and_remove.

Accepted amendments were applied: (1) grazing test now uses assert_or_dump() instead of bare assert!(), (2) run_grazing() in e2e now has 3 ensure_trace_delta() calls verifying periphyton drawdown, TAN increase, and fine-detritus increase, (3) both water-change tests include source.nitrite_mg_n_per_l in expected_n_import formula.
